# Lean Musical Protocol (LMP)

> An ultra-lean, token-efficient text-to-MIDI music sequencing protocol engineered specifically for Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous agent workflows.

LMP acts as an intermediate language between AI models and binary MIDI data. It replaces repetitive JSON/XML and error-prone delta-time arithmetic with a Space-Separated Value (SSV) grid, absolute quarter-note timestamps, stateful header defaults, and deterministic MIDI compilation.

## Specifications & AI Prompts

- [LMP All-in-One AI Specification](specs/ai/LMP-AI-FULL.md): Master AI prompt guide combining general rules, melodic chords, voice leading, percussive grooves, and strict syntax constraints into a single document.
- [LMP General AI Guide](specs/ai/LMP-AI-General.md): The primary ~2,200-token prompt guide for general LLM music composition.
- [LMP Melodic Guide](specs/ai/LMP-AI-Melodic.md): In-depth guide for voice leading, chords, pitch bends, CC controllers, and monophonic legato phrasing.
- [LMP Percussive Guide](specs/ai/LMP-AI-Percussive.md): Guide for drum sequencing, General MIDI percussion maps, repeating grid loops, and groove accents.
- [LMP Core Technical Specification](specs/LMP%20v1%20-%20Spec.md): Complete formal EBNF syntax, lexical rules, and AST compiler specification.
- [Soundiron Tablas 2.0 Drummap Example](specs/ai/Custom%20Drummap%20Examples/Indian%20Tablas/LMP-AI-Tabla.md): Example custom @MAP dictionary and AI prompt for Indian classical tabla percussion.

## Optional & Tools

- [LMP Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](lmp-mcp/README.md): Official stdio MCP server for compile, decompile, and validation inside Claude Desktop and Cursor.
- [LMP Core Compiler & Decompiler](compiler-js/README.md): Zero-dependency Node.js/browser compiler and decompiler with 136 core unit tests.
- [LMP Web Playground](playground-web/README.md): Interactive WebAudio playground with canvas piano roll, transport controls, and playhead tracking.
- [LMP-Bench Benchmark Suite](bench/README.md): Evaluation harness and statistical stress testing suite across 7 musical genres.
